rights_review.ministry_assignments: The public UI exposes separate assignment tables, but the footer reserves rights and the observed Privacy & Policy link leads to an Under Development page. An exact bulk reuse/redistribution grant was not verified; this is not a conclusion that every Kuwait public dataset prohibits reuse.
rights_review.upu_reference: The visually reviewed addressing sheet is printed 07/2002. Its 2020 HTTP modification date is not a current assignment edition. Examples are not current assignments or geometry and are not copied into the repository.
rights_review.paci_and_municipality: Public service metadata, viewer access and identifiers do not establish an unrestricted address/building/parcel export or an explicit permitted address-building relation. No identity, owner, title, resident, application or parcel-feature queries were made.
rights_review.csb: The landing page identifies Census 2011 and requires terms acceptance to enter; no acceptance was performed. Historical statistical geography is not current postal assignment.
